item.title: NMC campuses closed from Dec. 22 to Jan. 4
item.description: (NMC) — Northern Marianas College campuses on Saipan, Tinian, and Rota will be closed (with few exceptions) from Dec. 22, 2025, to Jan. 4, 2026. All offices will reopen on Monday, Jan. 5, 2026. The post NMC campuses closed from Dec. 22 to Jan. 4 appeared first on Marianas Variety News & Views.

item.title: Local startups take strategic steps toward growth
item.description: (NMC) — The CNMI Innovation Incubator Program recently concluded an impactful Business Planning and Strategy workshop, marking the launch of its Strategic Business Training Series for the inaugural cohort of local startups. The workshop took place on Dec.13, 2025, at the Incubator Makerspace of Beach Road Plaza, in collaboration with the Northern Marianas College Center for Training and Innovation. The post Local startups take strategic steps toward growth appeared first on Marianas Variety News

item.title: Commonwealth Medicaid Agency expands access to podiatry services
item.description: (CMA) — The Commonwealth Medicaid Agency is proudly advancing access to essential healthcare services with the issuance of Administrative Directive No. CMA2025-059, clarifying and expanding coverage for podiatry services under the CNMI Medicaid State Plan. The post Commonwealth Medicaid Agency expands access to podiatry services appeared first on Marianas Variety News & Views.

item.title: Smart gifts under $20
item.description: FINDING the perfect gift is usually a struggle between your heart and your bank account. This holiday season, we’re making it easy. We’ve scouted some of the best hidden gems in town to find stylish, useful, and fun ideas (and every single one is under $20). Whether you’re looking for a clever office exchange or a thoughtful "just because" gift, these budget wins prove you don't have to spend a fortune to deliver a lot of holiday joy. item.title: Reps. Aquino, Sablan lead two-day roadside cleanup in Precinct 2
item.description: REPRESENTATIVES Danny I. item.title: CBP reverses Shu Xiao removal
item.description: U.S. Customs and Border Protection has rescinded an expedited removal order against Shu Xiao, reversing a July 25 decision that barred him from reentry for five years. The post CBP reverses Shu Xiao removal appeared first on Marianas Variety News & Views.

item.title: Beauty queens encourage love of reading among daycare children
item.description: MISS Asia-Pacific Northern Marianas Anne Rivera-Brownstein, along with members of her court, visited daycare children on Thursday last week to promote childhood literacy, leadership, and community service. item.title: Residents urged to comment on offshore minerals plan
item.description: GOVERNOR David M. Apatang and Lt. Gov. Dennis James Mendiola are urging members of the community to share their input on the federal government’s plan to lease the continental shelf surrounding the CNMI for seabed mining. The post Residents urged to comment on offshore minerals plan appeared first on Marianas Variety News & Views.

item.title: OAG: Torres case may avoid trial
item.description: ASSISTANT Attorney General David Karch said Wednesday that the Office of the Attorney General is pursuing a “non-trial disposition” in the case against former Gov. Ralph DLG Torres, who faces charges of misconduct in public office, theft of government funds through premium-class airline travel, and contempt of the Legislature for failing to comply with a subpoena. The post OAG: Torres case may avoid trial appeared first on Marianas Variety News & Views.
